sources.title: Where is DiDi available?
sources.proves: Official list includes Brisbane and Gold Coast in Queensland and Sydney in New South Wales. Whitsundays/Airlie Beach was not observed as an exact city label in the fetched list.

sources.title: Cities
sources.proves: Official New Zealand service-city page lists Auckland, Christchurch and Wellington. Bay of Islands is not listed as a service city.

sources.title: Brisbane ferries
sources.proves: Brisbane has current CityCat and ferry services and official stop/timetable links.

sources.title: CityCat and ferry services
sources.proves: Council confirms CityCat/ferry operations and terminal context, including Northshore Hamilton and UQ St Lucia corridor endpoints.

sources.title: 50 cent fares
sources.proves: A flat AUD 0.50 fare applies per journey across Translink, including Brisbane CityCat and ferry services; Airtrain is excluded.

sources.title: F1 Manly
sources.proves: Official current ferry route connects Circular Quay and Manly Wharf.

sources.title: Adult fares
sources.proves: Official Opal/contactless fare framework and current caps; the dynamic ferry distance table did not render in the scrape, so no route-specific Manly fare is asserted.

sources.title: Ferry patronage
sources.proves: Official source exists for monthly ferry patronage by route/system. A verified annual F1 total was not extracted in this pass.

sources.title: Hopo Gold Coast Ferry
sources.proves: Current tourism ferry product on Gold Coast waterways. Search/fetched content supports Sea World and Surfers Paradise service; current stop-by-stop timetable and fare basis need live recheck.

sources.title: Resort Connections Fares
sources.date: fares updated 2026-04-11; Daydream prices valid 2026-04-01 to 2027-03-31
sources.proves: Current per-person fares and terminals: Port of Airlie to/from Daydream Island AUD 49.50 adult; Port of Airlie to/from Hamilton Island AUD 74.50 adult; Hamilton Island Marina, Hamilton Island Airport and Whitsunday Coast Airport transfer links are described.

sources.title: Resort Connections Timetable
sources.proves: Current operator timetable framework for Port of Airlie, Daydream Island, Hamilton Island Marina and Hamilton Island Airport; individual daily departures should be frozen at model handoff because schedules change.

sources.title: Whitsundays Regional Snapshot
sources.proves: Whitsundays received 969,000 visitors and AUD 1.6 billion visitor spend in the year ending June 2024. This is regional visitor context only, not route demand.

sources.title: Whitsunday Coast Airport Annual Performance Plan
sources.proves: Reports 510,835 airport passenger movements for year ending December 2024. This is access-market throughput, not ferry demand.

sources.title: Ferry services
sources.proves: Official current Auckland ferry network and links to timetables for Downtown, Devonport, Waiheke and other terminals.

sources.title: Ferry fares
sources.proves: Fares are one-way unless stated; Downtown–Devonport same-day adult day-trip ticket is NZD 23. AT HOP/contactless and route-specific exceptions are documented.

sources.title: Public transport fare changes 2026
sources.proves: Official 2026 adult inner-harbour ferry fare is NZD 7.80 by HOP/contactless and NZD 12 cash; exact inclusion of each candidate terminal must follow AT's route category.

sources.title: Auckland Transport Annual Report 2025
sources.proves: Official annual report is the correct patronage source. A ferry-only annual total was not reliably extracted in this pass and remains null.

sources.title: Bay of Islands passenger ferry
sources.proves: Three passenger ferry services operate between Paihia and Russell; this validates both terminals and the current corridor.

sources.title: Bay of Islands Ferry
sources.proves: Operator confirms Paihia–Russell passenger ferry and Opua–Okiato vehicle ferry. Paihia–Russell adult passenger fare shown is NZD 19.40 return; crossing is approximately 15 minutes per official destination listing/search evidence.

sources.title: Wellington Harbour Ferry
sources.proves: Current commuter service runs Queens Wharf–Days Bay, with some trips continuing to Matiu/Somes Island. Adult Queens Wharf–Days Bay one-way fare is NZD 17; Matiu/Somes tickets are return and booking requirements apply.

sources.title: Days Bay – Queens Wharf – Matiu/Somes Island timetable
sources.proves: Current dated timetable for the Wellington harbour ferry endpoints and Matiu/Somes continuation.

sources.title: Brisbane Airport Welcomes 22.6 million Passengers in FY24
sources.proves: 22.6 million airport passengers in FY2024, an access-market throughput signal only.

sources.title: Sydney Airport Annual Traffic Performance Q4 2024
sources.proves: More than 41 million passengers passed through Sydney Airport terminals in calendar 2024; this is not F1 Manly demand.

sources.title: Passenger Traffic Statistics
sources.proves: Gold Coast Airport connects more than 6 million travellers each year. The embedded dashboard did not expose a precise annual series in the scrape.

sources.title: FY25 Modern Slavery Statement
sources.proves: Auckland Airport welcomed 18.7 million passengers in FY2025; airport throughput is not ferry-route demand.

sources.title: Annual Review 2025
sources.proves: FY2025 domestic passengers 4,525,989 and international passengers 790,869, totaling 5,316,858 by explicit arithmetic. This is airport access-market throughput only.
